choices.tyre_life_edge: as_of_snapshot (history extended by the tyre ages seen so far)

reporting.text:
# Pre-registered reporting choices for the evaluation rerun (src/eval/reporting.py, docs/eval.md
# "Pre-registered reporting"). Committed before the held-out set exists. The tables stage reads
# this file and copies it verbatim, with its sha256, into provenance.json; the scenarios stage
# records its sha256 in a report set's sampling, and the tables stage refuses a report set
# (development false) whose recorded sha256 differs from this file's. Editing this file after a
# report set is built therefore stops its tables.

question: does the agent beat the simple rules?

comparisons:
  # agent minus each comparator, in this order
  lead: [run_to_flag, one_stop_total]
  secondary:
    actual_strategy: the teams
    belief_optimizer: what the language model adds over its tools
  reference_only: [fixed_one_stop, fixed_two_stop]
  footnote:
    greedy_crossover: unavailable on about 80% of scenarios (the plan stops immediately)

statistic:
  value: mean paired difference in regret_s, agent minus comparator, on scenarios both scored
  sign: negative means the agent is better
  interval: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap
  primary_cluster: race_driver      # (race_id, driver) clusters
  beside_cluster: race              # race_id clusters, reported beside (the held-out set has nine races)
  resamples: 2000
  seed: 0
  level: 0.95
  verdict:                          # from the primary interval
    ahead: the interval excludes zero on the agent's side (entirely below zero)
    behind: the interval excludes zero on the other side (entirely above zero)
    level: otherwise

tail:
  threshold_s: 20                   # the stated threshold: share of decisions more than 20 s from the reference
  beside_s: [10, 30]
  also: [median, worst]

held_out:
  # reported three ways, in this order; each race named by season and event
  groups:
    - name: fresh five
      label: the five races never examined before this run, the primary test of the corrected system
      races:
        - {season: 2021, event: france}
        - {season: 2021, event: mexico}
        - {season: 2022, event: miami}
        - {season: 2022, event: australia}
        - {season: 2022, event: belgium}
    - name: earlier four
      label: a second look, the four races scored once under the superseded protocol
      races:
        - {season: 2019, event: monaco}
        - {season: 2020, event: sakhir}
        - {season: 2024, event: austria}
        - {season: 2025, event: austria}
    - name: all nine
      label: every held-out race
      races: all
  by_era: true
  development_beside: dev20, reported beside the held-out results and labelled development

run_settings:
  agent_passes: 1
  model: qwen3-30b-a3b
  AGENT_TURN_REPEAT: run
  timing_sample: 24                 # isolated, sequential: the reported decision time
  jobs: 10
  configs: the default world and belief configs at the tagged commit
  per_race: 25
  seed: 0
  sampling_rule: as_of

handling:
  - invalid and unavailable rows are counted and shown per policy
  - a comparison uses only the scenarios both policies scored
  - no scenario, race or row is dropped after the fact
  - nothing is rerun; a resumed pass skips finished scenarios

fidelity_context: >-
  The judge orders close finishers correctly 0.753 of the time (ceiling 0.745) and its gap between
  two cars is off by 13.2 s on average (floor 3.2 s); absolute regrets of 4-10 s sit inside that,
  so paired differences carry the claims.

agent_run.headline: the decision time reported is the isolated timing sample's (timing_sample.csv: K episodes run sequentially, one job, before the pass); the full pass's per-episode latency_s was measured with agent_jobs episodes running concurrently and is reported beside it, not as the decision time
agent_run.latency_measured_under: 10 concurrent episodes (agent_jobs) in the full pass; other users of the endpoint are not controlled

retry_policy.retried: 429, 5xx, timeouts, dropped connections; 401/403 stop the pass

commands: python -m src.eval.rerun baselines --set dev20 --out-dir <out-dir> --world-config default --belief-config default --jobs 4
python -m src.eval.rerun agent --set dev20 --out-dir <out-dir> --world-config default --belief-config default --timing-sample 24 --jobs 10 --progress-every 25
